profile.description: Evercore Inc., formerly known as Evercore Partners, is a global independent investment banking advisory firm founded in 1995 by Roger Altman, David Offensend, and Austin Beutner. The firm has advised on over $4.7 trillion of merger, acquisition, and restructuring transactions since its founding.
profile.description_zh: Evercore Inc.（前身为Evercore Partners）是一家全球独立的投资银行咨询公司，由罗杰·奥特曼、大卫·奥芬森德和奥斯汀·博伊特纳于1995年创立。自成立以来，该公司已为超过4.7万亿美元的并购、重组交易提供咨询。
